title: Requiem of Hell
statusNote: Logos, intro movie, main menu and options work; a new game plays its opening scenes, hero choice, name entry and dialogue and then the first fight, where the hero moves and attacks and the inventory, map and pause menu open. The small yellow text (dialogue, options, inventory) is drawn with rows of pixels missing and is hard to read.
notes: A new game starts with a long story. Hold 7 for a second or two to skip the intro movie and the opening scene (the movie sometimes needs a second press). Then highlight a hero with left or right before confirming with 5, press 5 to advance the dialogue, and confirm your name with the star key (5 and the other digits type letters there).
The keys can be changed in the game under Options > Control Options.

Multiplayer puts a second player's hero into the host's game over Bluetooth, between two players in one room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer). Both need a saved game first (the pause menu's Save Game, once the first fight has begun). One chooses Multiplayer > Host Game, a save and Start; the other Join Game, a save and Start, then the host in the list and Select; the host answers "... is trying to join the game" with Accept. Options > Bluetooth Options shows the Bluetooth switch and the name.

multiplayer.menu: Multiplayer > Host Game / Join Game (each player loads a saved game)
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room, each with a saved game: one chooses Host Game and its save, the other Join Game, its save and the host in the list; the host accepts. Both heroes then stand in the host's world, and what one does (walking, an attack) shows on the other's screen. One player's pause is announced to the other. When the joiner quit, the host kept the "paused" message until it chose Quit.

controls.source: The game's Options > Control Options screen (its defaults; the text there is damaged, so the tenth function, on 7, could not be read). Moving, attacking, the inventory, the map, the pause menu and the keys used in the story screens were observed in play.

actions.rsk: Pause menu; back; close the inventory

notes: The keyboard uses the standard layout (arrows and the digit row). On a gamepad A is OK (menus), X attacks (5), B defends (4), Y is the combo strike (6); the shoulder buttons and the left trigger are the three magic attacks, the right trigger throws an item; Back opens the inventory, Start the pause menu and pressing the left stick shows the map. Right stick up is the star key (confirm the name), right stick down is 7 (skip a movie).
